'''Chapter 575''' is titled "Voiceless Rage".

==Cover Page==
[[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] and Animals: [[Sanji]] and [[Usopp]] relaxing and watching the stars while riding a camel.

==Short Summary==
Following the death of [[Portgas D. Ace]] at the hands of [[Admiral]] [[Sakazuki|Akainu]], [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] has gone into shock and is now in danger of death. Akainu moves to eliminate Luffy, but [[Polo Marco|Marco]] comes to his aid and stops Akainu while [[Jinbe]] escapes with Luffy. An enraged [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]] attacks Akainu and knocks him into a huge fissure while simultaneously splitting [[Marineford]] into two pieces. However, Akainu manages to burn off a portion of Whitebeard's head. Just then, the [[Blackbeard Pirates]] arrive at the battlefield along with some new crew members, one of which is an immense figure the size of Marineford's main building. [[Sengoku]] and the [[Marines]] are stunned.

==Long Summary==
The chapter starts with a flashback of [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]] and [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] having a drink and becoming brothers. Everyone is sad because of Ace's death. [[Emporio Ivankov|Ivankov]] notes that [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] has mentally collapsed and that his life is now in danger. [[Sakazuki|Akainu]] attempts to kill Luffy, but [[Polo Marco|Marco]] interrupts the attack. Marco orders [[Jinbe]] to take Luffy with him. Marco swears that the [[Whitebeard Pirates]] will protect him in place of [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]] and if they let him die, they would consider it shame on the entire Whitebeard Pirates. Whitebeard, who was observing the situation, attacks Akainu from the back without saying a word. [[Sakazuki|Akainu]] goes down and his face is covered in blood. Akainu retaliates with a punch that takes out a portion of Whitebeard's head. Whitebeard then punches Akainu a second time which also causes massive destruction to the Marine HQ itself. Akainu falls into the crevice created by Whitebeard and is therefore beaten by him. The Marineford plaza is split in two by the crevice and the pirates are separated from Whitebeard. Sengoku comments on how Whitebeard still has this much power, even after losing a portion of his head. The pirates are getting back to the ship. [[Boa Hancock]] tells her snake pet [[Salome]] that she is worried about Luffy. The [[Blackbeard Pirates]] are then spotted standing on the execution platform with some additional members. [[Sengoku]], shocked by their presence, questions how they got there. [[Donquixote Doflamingo|Doflamingo]] just comments how awesome it is that they got a great guest. [[Marshall D. Teach|Blackbeard]] himself says that he is glad he got there in time to see Whitebeard die.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] mentally collapses because of [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]]'s death.
*[[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]] retaliates against [[Sakazuki|Akainu]] and deals a serious blow to him.
*[[Boa Hancock]]'s snake, [[Salome]], is named.
*Blackbeard and his crew make it to Marineford.
**There are additional members to the [[Blackbeard Pirates]].
